title: Text to Dialogue: Multi-Speaker AI Conversations in ElevenLabs
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: Text to Dialogue: Multi-Speaker AI Conversations in ElevenLabs.

Text to Dialogue turns a script into a natural, expressive conversation between several voices, using Eleven v4 or Eleven v3. This episode explains how each turn pairs text with a voice, the three kinds of audio tags, how punctuation creates interruptions and trailing lines, the Python quickstart and CLI, the 2,000-character request guideline, and audio effects for placing the scene.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
